item.title: US child, teen obesity rates reach record high while adult trends appear to slow, CDC report finds
item.description: U.S. childhood and teen obesity rates have reached record-highs while adult obesity rates may be slowing, according to two new reports published early Wednesday by the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC).

item.title: El Monte organizers push for sanctuary ordinance amid Trump's immigration crackdown
item.description: Community groups are urging the El Monte City Council to pass a sanctuary ordinance they say is needed to protect immigrants.

item.title: Potential record-breaking heat coming to SoCal, followed by cooldown
item.description: A late February warmup brings summer-like temperatures to SoCal, with the heat expected to peak Friday.

item.title: Public Storage announces corporate relocation from California to Texas
item.description: Public Storage is leaving California and moving its corporate headquarters from Glendale to Frisco -- the latest in a series of corporate relocations from California to Texas.

item.title: Met Gala reveals 2026 dress code: 'Fashion is Art'
item.description: The dress code for the 2026 gala is "Fashion is Art," according to Vogue.

item.title: Parishioners at LA church pray for peace in Mexico after violence sparked by cartel leader's death
item.description: A Boyle Heights church held a prayer service calling for peace in Mexico after the death of a notorious cartel leader sparked a wave of violence.

item.title: FBI serves search warrants at LAUSD headquarters and superintendent's home
item.description: The FBI served search warrants at LAUSD headquarters and the home of Superintendent Alberto Carvalho. An additional raid was also conducted in Florida.

item.title: FBI hazmat team swarms Irvine home in gated community
item.description: The FBI descended on a home in a gated community in Irvine after police responded to a report of "suspicious circumstances" earlier in the week.

item.title: Man accused of poisoning Santa Clarita couple by spraying bug spray on food
item.description: A Santa Clarita couple is speaking out after their roommate allegedly poisoned them, leading to a standoff with deputies. Video shows the man spraying bug spray on their groceries.

item.title: CA governor candidate Steve Hilton says 'everybody supports' Trump's immigration policies
item.description: Leading in some polls in the wide-open California Governor's race as the June primary creeps closer is Republican and former Fox News host Steve Hilton.
